highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed image, text-shaping, and stream handling performance.
highlights_body: It reduces managed and native allocation pressure during pixel copies and feature-string decoding, while ensuring front-buffered streams do not retain data longer than necessary.

bullets.detail: Reduces overhead when copying image pixels through the managed API, improving throughput for pixel-processing workloads.
Pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocations without changing feature decoding behavior.
Fixes stream retention so buffered data is not kept alive longer than needed.
